text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara took part in an exhibition race
held at a certain event.
On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hau~ I lost again.
But I'm sure I'll win next time!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best at training, alright?
Let's do our best at training, okay?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Alright, let's do this!

Haru Urara keeps smiling no matter how much she loses.
I really want to help her win somehow, seeing how bright and positive she stays, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey... isn't that the girl
who just lost big in the last race?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Umm, if I remember correctly, was it Haru Urara?

...I can hear people gossiping
from far away...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: It was just an exhibition race, so maybe she was taking it easy?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, seriously, she just can't win at all.
Looks like she's been totally hopeless even before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
In a way, that's actually amazing.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
They're talking about me!

Haru Urara dashed off toward
the people who were gossiping...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you watch my race earlier?
And then you said I was amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: U-Um...

When I caught up, Haru Urara was pressing in on the startled spectators.
Her eyes were sparkling...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, that's right!
I'm pretty amazing, huh!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I love running, but
I'm not very fast, so I lose most of the time!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Still, next time I'm definitely, definitely going to win! Next time, I'll be the one hearing, "You won, that's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So please cheer for me again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm heading home!
Bye-byee!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll cheer for that girl.
She looks like she's really trying hard...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: M-Me too...

...To an Umamusume, the fans' support is immense.
Haru Urara's natural charm that makes people want to cheer for her
might become a powerful weapon going forward.

"Even so, first I need to help her consistently
win races...
Thinking this, I chased after Haru Urara."
